title: Senior Accountant
description:
**Hiring Partner:** Camellia Staffing  
**Location:** Sarkhej, Ahmedabad  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**CTC:** ₹4.5 – ₹5.5 LPA  
**Open Positions:** 1  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiner Preferred  
**Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com / Accounts or Finance Background

About the Opportunity

Camellia Staffing is hiring a **Senior Accounts Executive** for one of our clients, a growing tech-enabled logistics organization operating in the supply chain and logistics sector.

The organization focuses on technology-driven and data-led logistics operations, with an emphasis on operational efficiency, sustainability, and continuous improvement.

We are looking for an experienced accounting professional who can independently manage core accounting operations, reconciliations, taxation support, MIS reporting, and vendor/customer coordination.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting activities.
* Prepare regular **MIS reports** and accounting summaries.
* Monitor **Accounts Receivable (AR)** and **Accounts Payable (AP)**.
* Prepare vendor payment sheets as per internal payment policies.
* Compile accounting data required for **GST and TDS returns**.
* Perform periodic **ledger scrutiny and reconciliations**.
* Coordinate with customers and vendors regarding accounting-related requirements.
* Support statutory audits and coordinate with auditors for required documentation.
* Ensure timely submission of accounting and compliance-related information.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date accounting records.
* Ensure overall accounting hygiene and compliance with applicable processes.
* Identify discrepancies and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for resolution.

Skills & Experience RequiredExperience

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in accounting or finance.
* Hands-on experience in managing accounting operations.

Technical Skills

* Strong proficiency in **Microsoft Excel**.
* Experience with accounting software/ERP systems.
* Good understanding of bookkeeping and financial reporting.
* Sound knowledge of **GST and TDS**.
* Experience in ledger scrutiny and reconciliations.

Soft Skills

* Strong attention to detail.
* Good analytical and numerical skills.
* Ability to multitask and manage deadlines.
* Strong organizational and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

Language Skills

* Excellent communication skills in **English, Hindi, and Gujarati**.

Education

* B.Com / M.Com preferred.
* Candidates with an equivalent background in Accounts or Finance may also be considered.

Why This Opportunity?

* Work with a growing organization in the **technology-enabled logistics sector**.
* Opportunity to handle diverse accounting and compliance responsibilities.
* Exposure to MIS, taxation, reconciliations, vendors, customers, and audits.
* Stable, full-time work-from-office opportunity.

**Immediate joiners are preferred.**

Apply Through Camellia Staffing

Interested candidates can share their updated CV with **Camellia Staffing** for evaluation and further interview coordination.

Pay: ₹450,000.00 - ₹550,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience?
* Do you have practical experience with GST and TDS compliance?
* Do you have experience in ledger scrutiny, bank reconciliation, and account reconciliation?
* Are you proficient in Microsoft Excel and accounting/ERP software?
* What is your notice period? (in days)
* What is your current CTC? (per month)
* What is your expected CTC? (per month)
* Do you have hands-on experience using Zoho Books?
* Have you managed sales, purchase, expense, and journal entries in Zoho Books?
* Have you performed bank reconciliation and ledger reconciliation in Zoho Books?
* Have you used Zoho Books for GST-related accounting and reporting?

title: Admin cum Accountant
description:
We are looking for a **responsible, organised, and detail-oriented Admin & Accounts Executive** to support our company's day-to-day accounting, banking, documentation, and administrative activities.

The role will primarily involve **managing Zoho Books, coordinating with our Accounts team and CA, handling banking-related documentation, maintaining company and individual records, and following up on accounting, GST, and other official matters**.

Freshers are welcome to apply. We are more interested in someone who is **responsible, quick to learn, comfortable with technology, and able to use AI tools effectively**.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounts & Zoho Books**

* Maintain and regularly update company accounts in **Zoho Books**.
* Record and maintain sales, purchases, expenses, receipts, payments, and other financial transactions.
* Maintain invoices, bills, receipts, and supporting financial documents.
* Assist with bank reconciliation and routine accounting activities.
* Track outstanding payments, receipts, and other accounting-related items.
* Coordinate with the internal Accounts team and **Chartered Accountant (CA)** for accounting, GST, taxation, and compliance requirements.
* Provide required reports, statements, and documents to the Accounts team and CA.

**Banking & Financial Coordination**

* Coordinate with banks regarding routine account-related matters.
* Prepare and submit documents required by banks for **Overdraft (OD), credit facilities, account-related requests, KYC, and other banking requirements**.
* Maintain proper records of bank correspondence and submitted documents.
* Follow up with bank officials on pending requests and documentation.
* Visit banks when required to submit documents, collect documents, meet bank officials, or resolve pending matters.

**CA, GST & Government Office Coordination**

* Coordinate with the company's CA and Accounts team for pending accounting, GST, taxation, and compliance matters.
* Collect, submit, and follow up on required documents.
* Visit the **CA office, GST office, or other relevant offices** when required.
* Meet concerned officers or representatives to submit documents and follow up on pending matters.
* Maintain proper records of applications, acknowledgements, letters, notices, and other official documents.

**Company, Employee & Personal Documentation**

* Maintain organised physical and digital records of **company documents and authorised individual documents**.
* Maintain records of certificates, registrations, agreements, KYC documents, bank documents, tax documents, and other important paperwork.
* Maintain **employee attendance, leave records, and other staff-related documentation**.
* Ensure important documents are properly named, organised, scanned, and securely stored.
* Keep track of documents that need renewal, submission, or follow-up.
* Ensure confidential financial, company, employee, and personal information is handled securely.

**General Administration**

* Handle routine office administrative work and documentation.
* Prepare letters, applications, declarations, forms, reports, and other official documents when required.
* Maintain professional email communication with banks, CA offices, government offices, and other external parties.
* Assist management and the Accounts team with day-to-day administrative and financial tasks.
* Take ownership of pending tasks and ensure proper follow-up until completion.

**AI & Technology Skills**

We are a technology-focused company and expect the candidate to use **AI tools as part of their daily work**.

* Ability to effectively use **ChatGPT and Google Gemini** for research, drafting emails/letters, preparing documents, understanding accounting or banking requirements, and completing routine tasks.
* We will provide access to **ChatGPT Plus and Gemini Pro** where required.
* Candidate should be comfortable learning new software and using technology to improve productivity.
* Ability to use AI to find solutions independently instead of relying on others for every small task.

Skills & Requirements

* **Freshers are welcome to apply.**
* Basic understanding of accounting and financial transactions.
* Good knowledge of **Google Sheets**,**MS Excel and MS Word**.
* Familiarity with **Zoho Books** is an advantage, but training can be provided to the right candidate.
* Good English communication skills, particularly for professional emails and documentation.
* Good organisational and documentation skills.
* Comfortable dealing with banks, CA offices, and government departments.
* Willingness to travel locally for official work when required.
* Good attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work independently and follow up on pending tasks.
* Honest, responsible, and trustworthy, especially when handling financial and confidential documents.
* **Strong willingness to learn and use AI tools efficiently.**

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who is:

* **Tech-savvy and comfortable using AI tools.**
* Responsible and trustworthy.
* Good with documentation and numbers.
* Organised and detail-oriented.
* Comfortable communicating with banks, CAs, and government officials.
* Proactive in following up on pending work.
* Able to take ownership instead of waiting for instructions for every task.
* Willing to learn accounting, banking, GST, and compliance processes.

**JOB SUMMARY**

Functions as the property’s strategic financial business leader. The position champions, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property employees. The position provides the financial expertise to enable the successful implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives while maximizing the return on investment. * 4-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; 2 years experience in the finance and accounting or related professional area.

OR

* Master's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; no work experience required.

* Analyzes financial data and market trends.

* Analyzes information, forecasts sales against expenses and creates annual budget plans.

* Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.

* Develops means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc.

title: Head - Accounts & Finance
description:
**Job Description**

**Accounts & Finance Head**

**Position:** Accounts & Finance Head  
**Qualification:** Chartered Accountant (CA)  
**Experience:** 12–15 years of relevant experience  
**Industry Preference:** Real Estate / Construction / Infrastructure /Service Sector  
**Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / Chairman / COO

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Accounts & Finance Head** to lead the organisation's finance, accounting, taxation, treasury and financial control functions.

The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring strong financial governance, accurate reporting, effective cash-flow management, statutory compliance, budgeting, MIS and financial planning. The role will also act as a strategic finance partner to the management and business teams.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Financial Management & Reporting**

* Lead the overall finance and accounting function of the organisation.
* Ensure timely and accurate preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements.
* Prepare and present financial MIS, management reports and dashboards to senior management.
* Analyse financial performance, profitability, costs and key financial indicators.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to management for business decisions.
* Establish and monitor appropriate financial controls and accounting processes.

**2. Budgeting & Financial Planning**

* Lead the annual budgeting and business planning process.
* Prepare budgets, forecasts and financial projections.
* Monitor actual performance against budget and analyse variances.
* Develop financial models and scenario analysis for business and project decisions.
* Support management in evaluating new projects, investments and expansion plans.

**3. Cash Flow & Treasury Management**

* Manage the organisation's overall cash flow and working capital.
* Prepare rolling cash-flow forecasts and ensure optimum utilisation of funds.
* Monitor receivables, payables, advances and outstanding collections.
* Manage banking relationships, working capital facilities and financial arrangements.
* Ensure timely payments while maintaining adequate liquidity.

**4. Accounting & Internal Controls**

* Supervise accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, receivables and reconciliations.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and company accounting policies.
* Strengthen internal financial controls and identify potential financial risks.
* Implement processes to improve accuracy, efficiency and transparency of financial operations.
* Review accounting systems, processes and ERP/MIS reports.

**5. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure timely compliance with **GST, Income Tax, TDS, TCS and other applicable statutory requirements**.
* Coordinate with tax consultants and advisors on assessments, notices and tax matters.
* Review tax computations, returns and statutory filings.
* Ensure proper documentation and maintenance of statutory records.
* Keep management updated on significant changes in taxation and regulatory requirements.

**6. Audit & Compliance**

* Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors and tax auditors.
* Ensure timely completion of statutory, internal and tax audits.
* Review audit observations and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Establish a strong compliance and risk-control framework.
* Liaise with regulators, consultants, auditors, banks and other financial institutions as required.

**7. Real Estate / Project Finance – Preferred**

* Monitor project-wise financial performance, budgets and cash flows.
* Track project costs against approved budgets and identify cost overruns.
* Review project profitability and financial feasibility.
* Monitor project receivables, customer collections and project-related payables.
* Coordinate with project, procurement and commercial teams on financial matters.
